tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Accent: filled buttons, active nav, slider track, progress, focus rings, active lyric line. Violet in every theme.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills (filled button label, play glyph).

tokens.name: primary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal accent fill: selected nav pill, tonal button, selected chip, play FAB container.

tokens.name: primary-fixed
tokens.usage: Primary tone that stays the same across themes.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary accent: less prominent controls, secondary toggles.

tokens.name: secondary-container
tokens.usage: Tonal fill for secondary controls (segmented selected segment, filter chips).

tokens.name: tertiary
tokens.usage: Contrasting accent for highlights that must not read as primary (badges, stats).

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Errors: failed downloads, playback errors, destructive confirm.

tokens.name: error-container
tokens.usage: Tonal error fill (error banner, failed row badge).

tokens.name: surface-container
tokens.usage: Now Playing bar, filled cards, search bar fill.

tokens.name: surface-container-high
tokens.usage: Track menu card, media card art placeholder, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-container-highest
tokens.usage: Text field fill, switch track off, the most raised container.

tokens.name: surface-variant
tokens.usage: Alternate surface for grouped settings rows.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Tint applied to elevated surfaces; equals primary.

tokens.name: on-surface
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface: titles, track names, lyrics.

tokens.name: on-surface-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text: artist, duration, labels, inactive icons.

tokens.name: inverse-on-surface
tokens.usage: Text on inverse-surface (snackbar, plain tooltip). Fix: tokens.slint Dark and PureBlack set it to #f2eef7, identical to inverse-surface (1:1, text invisible); #322f35 is the M3 baseline dark value.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: Outlined button and chip borders, text field rest border, switch border.

tokens.name: outline-variant
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers, mood tile border.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Drop shadow color (cards at elevation, track menu at 0.32 alpha).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay scrim behind dialogs and the full player.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap inside rows and between chips.

tokens.usage: Card rail gap, mood grid gap, menu icon gap.

tokens.usage: Page margin, card padding, sidebar padding.

tokens.name: radius-extra-small
tokens.usage: Text field top corners, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: List rows, menu rows, pressed button morph target, selected icon button.

tokens.name: radius-medium
tokens.usage: Small buttons at rest, media cards, mood tiles, track menu.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills: chips, switches, search bar, segmented buttons, icon buttons (9999px sentinel).

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Elevated M3Card at rest (shadow role, blur 3px, offset 1px).

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: TrackMenu card: shadow at 0.32 alpha, blur 18px, offset 4px.

elevation.note: Shadow depth levels in px from Elevation in tokens.slint.

tokens.name: elevation-level2
tokens.usage: Track menu card and raised controls.

duration.note: Motion durations from Motion in tokens.slint; easing is ease-in-out for state, ease-out for lifts.

opacity.note: State layer alphas used by every component.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state layer opacity over content color.

tokens.name: state-disabled-container
tokens.usage: Disabled container fill alpha of on-surface.

easing.note: M3 easing curves for CSS and Slint cubic-bezier(). Proposal: the Slint code uses ease-in-out and ease-out today.

tokens.name: easing-emphasized
tokens.usage: Default for movement that starts and ends on screen: drawer slide, nav pill stretch, art shape change.

tokens.name: easing-emphasized-decelerate
tokens.usage: Entering: full player opening, dialogs, snackbar, track menu.

tokens.name: easing-emphasized-accelerate
tokens.usage: Exiting: closing the full player, dismissing dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Small utility changes: state layers, colour, opacity.

tokens.name: easing-standard-decelerate
tokens.usage: Small elements fading or sliding in.

tokens.name: easing-overshoot
tokens.usage: Approximates the expressive spatial spring where Slint has no spring: play button morph, connected transport, switch thumb.

spring.note: M3 Expressive motion scheme springs (damping ratio, stiffness), for reference when a platform supports springs.

tokens.name: spring-spatial-fast
tokens.usage: Small components moving: switch thumb, button morph.

tokens.name: spring-spatial-default
tokens.usage: Mid-size movement: nav pill, connected transport.

tokens.name: spring-spatial-slow
tokens.usage: Full-screen movement: full player, queue sheet.

tokens.name: spring-effects-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity on small components.

tokens.name: spring-effects-default
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity on mid-size surfaces.

tokens.name: spring-effects-slow
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity on full-screen surfaces.
